concerns.text: The plan references functional requirements FR‑015 and FR‑017 (e.g., “If a size‑bin is missing, fall back to a random subset …” and “Dataset Acquisition & Validation” list includes FR‑015, FR‑017), but these FR IDs are not defined anywhere in the specification (spec.md). This creates a mismatch between the plan and the spec.

The plan performs permutation‑based false‑positive‑rate estimation (Phase 6) but never mentions the `null_fpr_metrics.schema.yaml` contract that exists in the contracts directory. According to the cross‑doc rule, every contract must be exercised by at least one plan element.
